temporary_audio_cleanup_and_source_reten.detail: 6 passed. Active worker leases protect in-flight normalized audio; expired leases make abandoned normalized tempfiles reclaimable; decoder partial output is removed while its failure report is retained; preview expiry clears provisional artifacts and retains audio used by a saved transcript; reconciliation preserves unrelated files.

limitations: All lifecycle tests use synthetic artifacts. Expired lease is used to model an abandoned worker; the OS process was not force-killed during the test.
No cropped-audio artifact is generated by the current application path, so crop cleanup has no runtime artifact to exercise.
The cleanup code supports SQLite development storage; production storage retention and backup reclamation still require operational validation.
